classification: post-hoc descriptive selector-activity audit after the completed negative penalty diagnostic
trigger: Participant-level penalty comparisons showed no Holm-corrected benefit; determine whether fixed penalties actually changed physical recording-site subsets.
inputs: unchanged original fold-aggregation and fresh participant-aggregation curves, all43 outer participants, allfour fixed penalties and all16 counts
outputs: for each nonzero penalty/count/aggregation, number of changed site sets, participant-wise Jaccard similarity and score identity; retain every participant and count
rules: unordered physical site sets; no new fits, penalty values, seeds, margins or selection tuning; unchanged sets must reproduce allfour metrics within1e-12
interpretation: descriptive algorithm activity and redundancy, not a new superiority/equivalence test; this audit is motivated by observed outcomes and is not prespecified
